title: Android LinearLayout: text baseline alignment
purpose: Check that an Android XML horizontal LinearLayout aligns different text sizes on their text baseline by default, and that baselineAligned=false turns the alignment off.
changes: Added horizontal baseline alignment, its XML opt-out, and extra wrap-content height for mixed ascents and descents. The example has an aligned row and an unaligned row.
steps: Turn on Show baseline alignment. Two rows containing a small and a large word will appear.
In the first row, look at the bottoms of the letters, ignoring the part of the letter g that descends below the line. The small and large words should sit on the same imaginary baseline.
In the second row, baseline alignment is disabled in Android XML. Both colored text boxes start at the top, so the small word sits noticeably higher than the large word.
Turn on Right-to-left layout. The two words should reverse order, and the first row should retain its aligned baselines while the second remains unaligned.
Choose OK if the rows behave as described. Otherwise choose Reject and describe what looks wrong, which row or direction is affected, and your device.
expected: The default row aligns mixed-size text on a common baseline; the baselineAligned=false row keeps top-aligned text boxes. Changing layout direction reverses the order without changing that relationship.
limits: This test covers horizontal mixed-size text and the XML opt-out. Bhoo's renderer supplies the font metrics; exact Android font and pixel parity, baselineAlignedChildIndex, and baselines for other view types remain open.

references.scope: Default baseline alignment, XML opt-out, top/bottom gravity and wrap-content baseline measurement.

validation: All 153 Rust android_xml tests passed, including new baseline alignment, XML opt-out, RTL and wrap-content height cases.
All 135 Android XML importer tests passed, including baselineAligned true, false and invalid values.
Browser test-bhoo-linear-baseline.mjs passed rendered pixel checks for aligned and unaligned rows at 390px width, including RTL.
